name: Chicago food-facility commercial pest control (SW-side route) with residential/landlord plan line
summary: One IDPH-licensed pest company: founder becomes the Certified Technician, wins food establishments cited for live pests in CDPH inspections (SW cluster 60608/60609/60616/60623/60632), adds residential/2-6-flat landlord quarterly plans as a secondary line. Customer unit = blended service account (~75% commercial monthly, ~25% residential quarterly). Technician labor is modelled as capacity-triggered staff (founder services the first ~110 accounts); gross margin therefore covers materials/devices only.
evidence_notes: Demand: 1,416 Chicago food licences showed live pest evidence (droppings, roaches, flies, rodents) in CDPH inspections 2025-11-01..2026-11-25; 256 of these in the SW cluster out of 1,572 licences inspected there [A, DA-S001].

Pricing: restaurants ~$100-150/mo [D, C2-S020]; operator-published restaurant range $50-422/mo [D, C2-S019]; public per-building bids $30-180/mo [A, C2-S017]; Chicago residential monthly visits ~$40-70 [D, DA-S021]. No Chicago commercial rate card was found (MISSING).
Churn: Rentokil North America customer retention 80.7%/yr [B, C2-S009] -> ~1.8%/mo; ~10% of inspected Chicago food licences were found 'Out of Business' within 13 months [A, DA-S001].

Labour: Chicago MSA pest-control worker median $46,740 ($22.47/hr) [C, DA-S011]. Insurance: broker averages GL $112/mo, auto $114/mo, WC $90/mo for small pest firms [C, DA-S010]; statutory minimum limits per IDPH form [A, C2-S004].
Software: GorillaDesk published plans $49-149/mo first route [B, DA-S016]. Supplier: Veseris branch at 3642 S Kedzie Ave, Chicago, requires applicator licence number to open an account [B, DA-S014].

Win rates, lead volumes, CAC and one-time revenue are analyst assumptions (E) to be tested by the validation plan. Incumbent gross margin (Rollins 52.8% incl. labour) is incumbent economics, not used directly.

drivers.sales_start_delay_months__source: IDPH exams roughly monthly at Westchester, application due 15 days prior [A, C2-S005, WS05-S013]; business licence $250 + insurance certificate [A, WS05-S012, C2-S004]. Processing time itself MISSING.
drivers.sales_cycle_months__source: Restaurants decide in days after a citation; plants 1-3 months (Stage A/C, E).
drivers.founder_leads_per_month__source: Qualified owner/manager conversations from walk-ins at CDPH-cited licences (~20/mo with live pests in SW cluster, ~109/mo citywide [A, DA-S001]), new licences (~124/mo citywide [A, C2-S014]) and residential inbound. Conversation volume is E.
drivers.lead_to_proposal_pct__source: Analyst estimate; free inspection offered on the spot.
drivers.proposal_to_win_pct__source: Displacement sale (most cited sites already have a provider: 212 comments 'additional service needed' vs 98 no provider [A, C2-S014]); L.E.K. survey: ~37% of facility managers switched a provider in the past year [C, DA-S019].
drivers.rep_new_customers_per_month__source: Analyst estimate for a commissioned route-sales rep.
drivers.referral_new_per_100_active__source: Analyst estimate (owner networks, landlords with multiple buildings).
drivers.monthly_churn_pct__source: Rentokil NA retention 80.7%/yr [B, C2-S009] = 1.77%/mo; conservative adds new-entrant quality risk and restaurant closures [A, DA-S001].
drivers.arpc_monthly__source: Blend 75% commercial at ~$125/mo (restaurants $100-150 [D, C2-S020]; wholesale food plants higher, E) + 25% residential at ~$45/mo equivalent (Chicago monthly visit $40-70 [D, DA-S021]; quarterly plans ~$120-150/qtr, E).
drivers.onetime_revenue_per_new_customer__source: Initial cleanout + exclusion (1,267 of 3,182 CDPH pest comments cite door gaps/openings [A, DA-S001]); Rollins: ~25% of revenue non-recurring [A, C2-S008]. Ticket size E.
drivers.arpc_annual_growth_pct__source: Annual price increase assumption; L.E.K.: >95% of FMs have escalators in some multi-year contracts [C, DA-S019].
drivers.gross_margin_pct__source: Materials/devices/logbook consumables only (~9-12% of revenue, Stage C E); technician labour and vehicles are in Staff.
drivers.onetime_gross_margin_pct__source: Rodent stations, door sweeps, sealants installed at cost ~$80-110 per new account (E).
drivers.variable_opex_pct_revenue__source: Fuel/route variable + card fees + bad debt; Rollins fleet ~5.2% of revenue incl. ownership [A, C2-S008]; set 6% (fuel ~3%, processing 2%, bad debt 1%).
drivers.cac_per_new_customer__source: Commercial canvassing near-zero cash; residential paid leads (Google LSA) assumed $60-120/lead at ~40% close; blended E.
drivers.fixed_marketing_per_month__source: Website, Google Business, LSA floor budget, print (E).
drivers.dso_days__source: Rollins DSO ~20 days (incumbent) [A, C2-S008]; residential autopay; restaurants net-15.
drivers.dpo_days__source: Veseris offers an online credit application [B, DA-S014]; actual terms MISSING; conservative = card/COD.
drivers.start_capital_injection__source: Launch budget: equipment, insurance deposit, storage, 3 months overhead.
drivers.ev_multiple__source: Small recurring pest books are acquired actively (Rollins 26 deals in 2025 [A, C2-S008]); multiple not disclosed (MISSING) - 3.5x EBITDA assumed.

staff.notes: Chicago MSA median $46,740/yr [C, DA-S011] x ~1.25 load (payroll tax, WC, Chicago paid leave) = ~$4,870 + leased van/fuel ~$850. Capacity ~190 blended accounts (8-12 commercial stops/day; residential quarterly). Supervision rule allows uncertified techs [A, C2-S002]. Threshold uses base value (structural).
Scheduling, logbooks/audit reports, billing. Chicago wage $17.05 floor [A, DA-S013]; ~$45-50k loaded (E).

staff.role: Commercial sales rep (salary + commission), hired once the book reaches 300 accounts
staff.notes: E. Test: a salaried rep hired at month 20 regardless of scale cut base yr-3 operating profit to ~$4k, because at ~$105 ARPC a rep adding 4 accounts/mo needs >12 months to cover cost. Hire on scale, keep pay commission-heavy.
Second CT needed for a second licensed location [A, C2-S003]; E cost.
